WHAT'S INSIDE

Everything you need for directional conviction

Built for serious futures traders who want institutional-grade macro context before entering any position — not another lagging indicator.

Signal Constellation

Every model plotted on one map — bias against conviction. See at a glance where the weight of evidence sits, from high-conviction bullish to low-conviction noise.

  • Bias × confidence scatter across all active signals
  • Consensus read with net direction
  • A single 0–100 Bias Score — is macro aligned with your trade?

Regime Detection

Goldilocks, Reflation, Stagflation or Deflation — classified automatically from live FRED growth and inflation data, then translated into a strategy stance.

  • Weighted macro composite from −1 to +1
  • VIX, 10Y/2Y curve, DXY and HY credit spreads
  • Adjusts risk posture, strategy mode and stop distance

Dealer Greeks & Walls

Where dealers are forced to hedge is where price gets pinned — or where it breaks. Net gamma, delta, vanna and charm exposure with call & put walls and the gamma flip, converted to ES/NQ levels.

  • Positive vs negative gamma regime — pinned or explosive
  • Call wall (resistance), put wall (support), gamma flip
  • Refreshes every minute through the session

Intraday Levels & GEX Map

Gamma flip, call & put walls and open-interest levels converted to native ES & NQ prices — plus prior-day and overnight high/low/close, with the distance to every level in points.

  • Gamma flip, call & put walls in native ES/NQ points
  • Distance in points to every key level
  • PDH / PDL / PDC and overnight range

HOW IT WORKS

From raw data to a read — in one glance

1

We pull the data

FRED macro, CFTC COT, dealer gamma and live futures bars — refreshed continuously, so you never trade on a stale picture.

2

The engine fuses it

Twelve models score bias and conviction, classify the regime and locate the levels that matter for ES and NQ.

3

You get the bias

A clear directional read with a tactical note — before the open, so you enter with context instead of hope.
